title: What Anthropic’s IPO shares add up to across its $70 to $78 range
intro: Slide the share price across the range Anthropic set on 10 November. The number shows the price times the shares, in millions of dollars. Switch between all 825 million shares on offer and the 801,351,354 that Anthropic itself sells, which is the part whose money goes to the company.
note: Share counts and the $70 to $78 range are from Anthropic’s 10 November announcement. At $70 and $78, all 825 million shares come to $57,750 million and $64,350 million, matching TechCrunch’s $57.75 billion to $64.35 billion. These are gross amounts before underwriting fees and costs, and they leave out the underwriters’ option to buy up to 123,750,000 more shares. The final price is set at pricing, which CNBC’s sources put on 18 November, and may fall outside the range. This is not the company’s valuation, which counts all shares, not only those sold.
